title: 第6章 变数千机破局人第7章 劫外狂涛听潮起
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、变数入局·机关少女
中天棋盘「变数」位突然爆发出青铜齿轮转动声，黄沙中升起十二座人形机关傀儡，每具傀儡关节处都刻着太昊氏「八卦锁」符文。
傀儡分左右列阵，中间走出一名紫发少女，腰间挂着九环金铃（与风九幽的蛊铃形制相同），裙摆绣着机关术与蛊毒交织的图案。
百里无霜登场：
少女指尖轻抚傀儡眉心，金铃发出清脆却冰冷的声响：「隐世盟·百里氏第十八代机蛊师，百里无霜。
奉家祖之命，来会各位——劫中棋。
」她抬手抛出三枚菱形机关，落地化作毒雾屏障，屏障中隐约可见「试药人」三字残刻。
诗号：
「千机傀儡布星罗，万蛊成兵血作河。
莫道女儿无杀意，金铃响处锁魂多。
与风九幽的渊源：
风九幽瞳孔骤缩，青鳞下的血管突突跳动：「你腰间的金铃……是当年太昊氏「百蛊堂」的遗物！
」百里无霜冷笑，金铃展开成六芒星阵，阵中浮现风九幽当年被试药的记忆画面：「没错，吾父正是被你吸干精血的蛊师「百里长恨」。
二、机关蛊术·千机万蛊
百里无霜招式解析：
1.机关·千机变
十二具傀儡同时解体重组，化作巨蝎、毒蛛等机关兽，关节处喷出腐蚀性黏液。
萧素雪的冰盾遇上黏液瞬间融化，傀儡毒钳夹向她咽喉：「太昊氏机关术，可破天下万法！
2.蛊毒·万蚁噬心
金铃洒出荧光蚁群，每只蚂蚁都驮着微型机关弩。

凌九霄的龙气盾被弩箭穿透，蚂蚁钻进他伤口啃噬血肉，百里无霜轻哼：「这些小家伙，最爱吃带「王」气的肉。
3.终式·人蛊同葬
她扯断金铃锁链，露出颈间与风九幽相同的试药刺青，傀儡群突然自爆，化作漫天毒针：「以吾身为引，以汝为祭——千机蛊爆！
」毒针与测天丝相撞，竟织出太昊氏「生死簿」残页。
三、儒门内战·仁权之争
沈墨卿VS楚轩行：
楚轩行持「权」字笔凌空书写，每个字都化作青铜枷锁：「太学主可还记得，儒门为何能压过释道？因「仁」是幌子，「权」才是里子！
-沈墨卿反击：「诗经·无衣·同仇！
」惊鸿剑凝聚儒门先贤虚影，却见虚影们手中书册皆被「权」字染红，化作刽子手持刀斩来。
-道心崩塌：沈墨卿踉跄跪地，惊鸿剑上的《诗经》文字全部剥落，露出剑脊内侧刻着的「杀」字——正是当年楚轩行替他担下的罪孽。
楚轩行的新儒术：
「权术·三纲五常锁！
content_en:
1. Variables enter the game·Girl with agency
The "variable" position on the Zhongtian chessboard suddenly erupted with the sound of bronze gears turning, and twelve humanoid machine puppets rose from the yellow sand. The joints of each puppet were engraved with Taihao's "Bagua Lock" runes.
The puppets were arrayed on the left and right, and a purple-haired girl walked out of the middle. A nine-ring golden bell hung around her waist (the same shape as Feng Jiuyou's poison bell), and her skirt was embroidered with patterns intertwined with mechanism skills and poison.
Baili Wushuang appears:
The girl's fingertips caressed the puppet's eyebrows, and the golden bell made a clear but cold sound: "The Hidden World Alliance, the 18th generation of Baili's Gu Master, Baili Wushuang.
Following the order of the family ancestor, I came to meet you all - Jie Zhongqi.
” She raised her hand and threw three diamond-shaped mechanisms, which turned into a barrier of poisonous mist when they landed. The words "drug tester" could be faintly seen in the barrier.
Poetry number:
"Thousands of machine puppets spread across the stars, and thousands of poisons become soldiers and make rivers of blood.
I don't know that my daughter has no murderous intention, and there are many souls locked where the golden bell rings.
The origin of Feng Jiuyou:
Feng Jiuyou's pupils shrank suddenly, and the blood vessels under his blue scales pulsated: "The golden bell on your waist... is a relic of Taihao's "Hundred Gu Hall" back then!
" Baili Wushuang sneered, and the golden bell unfolded into a six-pointed star array. In the array, the memory of Feng Jiuyou being tested for the drug appeared: "Yes, my father is the Gu Master "Baili Longhen" whose blood was drained by you.
2. Organ Gu Technique·Thousands of Machine Gu
Analysis of Baili Wushuang's moves:
1. Mechanism·Thousands of opportunities
Twelve puppets disintegrated and reorganized at the same time, turning into giant scorpions, poisonous spiders and other mechanical beasts, with corrosive mucus spraying out from their joints.
Xiao Suxue's ice shield melted instantly when it encountered the mucus, and the poisonous pincers of the puppet clamped down on her throat: "Taihao's mechanism technique can defeat all methods in the world!
2. Poison·Thousands of Ants Eat the Heart
The golden bell sprinkles a colony of fluorescent ants, each carrying a miniature mechanical crossbow.
Ling Jiuxiao's dragon energy shield was penetrated by a crossbow arrow, and ants got into his wounds and gnawed at the flesh. Baili Wushuang hummed softly: "These little guys love to eat meat with "king" energy."
3. Final style·Buried with human poison
She tore off the golden bell chain, revealing the same test medicine tattoo as Feng Jiuyou's on her neck. The puppet group suddenly exploded, turning into poisonous needles all over the sky: "I will use my body as a guide, and you will be used as a sacrifice - Thousand Machine Gu explodes!
"The poisonous needle collided with the Tiansi silk and weaved out the remaining pages of Taihao's "Book of Life and Death".
3. The Confucian civil war and the struggle between benevolence and power
Shen Moqing VS Chu Xuanying:
Chu Xuanxing held the word "quan" and wrote in the air, and each word turned into a bronze shackle: "Master Taixue, do you still remember why Confucianism can prevail over Buddhism? Because "benevolence" is a cover, and "quan" is the inner truth!
-Shen Moqing counterattacked: "The Book of Songs·Wu Yi·Same Enemy!"
"The Jinghong Sword condensed the phantoms of the Confucian sages, but they saw that the books in the hands of the phantoms were dyed red with the word "quan", and they turned into executioners holding swords to chop them off.
- Tao Heart Collapse: Shen Moqing staggered to his knees, and all the words in the "Book of Songs" on the Jinghong Sword peeled off, revealing the word "kill" carved on the inside of the sword's spine - it was the sin that Chu Xuanxing had to bear for him back then.
Chu Xuanxing’s New Confucianism:
"Power Technique·Three Cardinal Guides and Five Constant Locks!"
